title: Why CJ really came home in GTA San Andreas
subject: cj
description:
Would you have stayed in Liberty City? 👇

How Carl Johnson's return to Los Santos turned into a frame job on day one. Spoilers for GTA San Andreas.

scenes.text: CJ came home for a funeral and walked into a war.
In 1987, his little brother Brian died, and his older brother Sweet blamed him. So Carl left for Liberty City.
Five years later, the phone rang. His mother, Beverly, had been killed in a drive-by on Grove Street.
He landed in Los Santos, and a police car was already waiting.
Officer Frank Tenpenny held a gun tied to a dead cop named Pendelbury, and CJ was going to take the blame.
They dropped him in Ballas territory, and he rode a stolen BMX home to Grove Street.
